subject: Quick swap for our call
text:
Hey, sorry for the last-minute scramble. My support queue moved, and our call in ten minutes probably will not work. Could we push it to Thursday afternoon instead? If you are free between one and three, I can send a fresh invite right away. I do not want you sitting by the screen waiting for a meeting that might not appear. If that window is bad, tell me a slot later this week and I will make it happen. There is no rush to reply, just let me know which works before we both get pulled into other things. I really appreciate you being flexible, especially when everything is so busy.

Talk soon.
